It's on the heavy side compared to what Hylians are used to, but it's very strong.|Allies|AoC}} Lynel Swords go unnamed in {{EoW}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 24 |durability = 26 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lynel Sword}} Lynel Swords are [[Weapon]]s wielded solely by [[Lynel]]s. They belong to the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons crafted by Lynels.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} Though most Lynels will increase in tier as [[Link]] defeats more [[Enemy|Enemies]], the Lynel on [[Ploymus Mountain]] will always remain a regular Lynel. This makes it a permanent source of Lynel Swords and other low tier [[Lynel Gear]]. In [[Master Mode]], though the Lynel on Ploymus Mountain remains the same, all other Lynels are tiered up to [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s. However, Blue-Maned Lynels will still make use of Lynel Swords, meaning they are still obtainable. Because they are made for smashing, Lynel Swords are heavier than standard swords. Lynel Swords can conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] due to being made of metal. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]], but they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_016" |Life = 26 |Power = 24 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 13 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 18 |BuyingPrice = 45 }} ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= EoW |type= Objects |category= |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where it can be found * Whether it can be interacted with and if it is important to the story or a Quest * Whether it can be copied as an Echo }} {{Stub|EoW}} Lynel Swords are [[Sword]]s wielded by [[Lynel]]s.
